name: Major Psionics (Ps)
body:
Prerequisite: Minor psionics, Intelligence 11, psionic subtype

Benefit(s): A rogue with this talent gains the ability to manifest a 1st-level power from the psion/wilder power list two times a day as a psi-like ability. The manifester level for this ability is equal to the rogue’s level. The save DC for this power is 11 + the rogue’s Intelligence modifier.
